description: Merge Tailwind CSS classes without style conflicts

latest_release.name: tailwind-merge@3.7.1
latest_release.body:
### Bug Fixes

- Fix font sizes without a line-height modifier removing earlier `leading-*` classes by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/761
    - In Tailwind CSS v4, an earlier `leading-*` class still applies after a font size like `text-lg` or `text-[1.5rem]`, so `twMerge('leading-6 text-lg')` now keeps both classes. Font sizes with a line-height modifier like `text-lg/7` still override `leading-*`.
    - Thanks to @chatman-media for finding this for arbitrary font sizes in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/681.
- Fix arbitrary values using `--spacing()` being classified as colors instead of lengths by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/758
- Fix `mask-circle` and `mask-ellipse` not merging by @0z5a in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/756
- Fix `flex-(--var)` not merging with other flex classes by @asssslay in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/751
- Fix `decoration-(--var)` being classified as thickness instead of color by @asssslay in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/753
- Fix arbitrary `line-clamp` values like `line-clamp-[calc(var(--characters)/100)]` not merging by @asssslay in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/752
- Fix `place-*` classes not overriding `content-*`, `items-*`, `self-*` and `justify-*` classes by @mkantautas in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/731
- Fix lengths using the `Q` unit not being recognized by @Marve10s in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/727
- Fix brackets and other delimiters inside quoted arbitrary values like `data-[label='[']` breaking class parsing by @Don-Yin in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/730
- Fix arbitrary values using `contrast-color()` or `device-cmyk()` being classified as lengths instead of colors by @Don-Yin in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/729
- Fix `sr-only` not overriding the position, size, spacing, overflow and white-space classes it resets by @kory-kaai in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/726
- Fix `mask-x-*` and `mask-y-*` not overriding the matching edge classes and arbitrary mask stop positions being classified as colors by @Nelmad in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/748
    - This also fixes arbitrary values using `--alpha()` or uppercase color functions like `RGB()` being classified as lengths instead of colors.
- Fix postfix modifiers not being recognized on classes with a leading important modifier like `!text-lg/7` by @beduldul in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/721

### Documentation

- Explain how classes are matched to class groups and how to use validators by @itsthilinar in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/750
- Show how to enforce importing `twMerge` from one place with ESLint by @oyobbeb in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/pull/738
- Recommend importing `twMerge` from one project-owned file by @dcastil in https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/commit/b53ceaf6e9900edf8edb03f65d0e2fbf5104adfa and https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/commit/7fcb814ea439b749aa18b72415b0e21837811853

**Full Changelog**: [`v3.7.0...v3.7.1`](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/compare/tailwind-merge@3.7.0...tailwind-merge@3.7.1)

Thanks to @manavm1990, @langy, @roboflow, @syntaxfm, @getsentry, @codecov, a private sponsor, @block, @openclaw, @sourcegraph, @jbisasky, @frontendmasters and more via @thnxdev for sponsoring tailwind-merge! ❤️

detail.readme: # tailwind-merge Utility function to efficiently merge [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) classes in JS without style conflicts. ```ts import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge' twMerge('px-2 py-1 bg-red hover:bg-dark-red', 'p-3 bg-[#B91C1C]') // → 'hover:bg-dark-red p-3 bg-[#B91C1C]' ``` - Supports Tailwind v4.0 up to v4.3 (if you use Tailwind v3, use [tailwind-merge v2.6.0](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/tree/v2.6.0)) - Works in all modern browsers and maintained Node versions - Fully typed, with published declarations compatible with TypeScript 3.8 and newer - [Check bundle size on Bundlephobia](https://bundlephobia.com/package/tailwind-merge) ## Get started - [What is it for](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/blob/tailwind-merge@3.7.1/packages/tailwind-merge/docs/what-is-it-for.md) - [Limitations](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/blob/tailwind-merge@3.7.1/packages/tailwind-merge/docs/limitations.md) - [Configuration](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge/blob/tailwind-merge@3.7.1/packages/tailwind-merge/docs/configuration.md) -
